dedupe_keys.name: therm and window lbnl window and building component heat transfer analysis

description: Two LBNL programs for heat transfer through building envelopes. WINDOW calculates total window thermal performance indices, namely U-values, solar heat gain coefficients, shading coefficients and visible transmittances, with a method consistent with the National Fenestration Rating Council procedure and ISO 15099; it serves product design, teaching and code development. THERM models two-dimensional heat transfer in windows, walls, foundations, roofs, doors, appliances and other products with thermal bridges, showing energy efficiency and local temperatures relevant to condensation, moisture damage and structural integrity. THERM results combine with WINDOW's centre-of-glass models for whole-product ratings, which in turn feed RESFEN for annual residential energy. Coverage: generic. Access: free downloads with documentation, a knowledge base and forums. Licence: LBNL licence linked from each tool. Caveats: THERM models two-dimensional heat flow only. Simulation uses: component thermal properties for whole-building energy models and condensation risk checks. Related records: EnergyPlus and WUFI.
